id.description: The event's own id. Stable across a retry of the same event.

ts.description: When it happened, by Chips' clock. Stamped on the way in; a value the sender writes is replaced.

workspace_id.description: A workspace identifier: `ws_` followed by a ULID.

space_id.description: The space, when the event belongs to one.

run_id.description: The run, when the event belongs to one.

seq.description: Assigned by the server on append, monotonic per workspace. Absent on the way in.

idempotency_key.description: Required on every client-originated write. Sending the same key twice is a no-op.

kind.description: Whether a person, a harness, one of a harness's agents or Chips itself acted.

id.description: The participant id, or `system` for Chips.

harness_id.description: For an agent: the harness it speaks through, whose budget and runs are the agent's (ADR 0087). Filled in by Chips.

actor.description: The participant an event is attributed to.

approval_id.description: A approval identifier: `apr_` followed by a ULID.

to.description: Who should answer, as the router asks it: `owner`, `any`, `role:<name>`, `lead`, or a person id — the same words as `approvers` on the request.

approvers.description: Who may answer now, as ids. Filled in by Chips from `to`; a value the sender writes is replaced.

ask.description: What the ask is, written by Chips from the approval. Somebody handed an ask in a room they are not in never saw the request that raised it (ADR 0042), and this is what their card is drawn from; whoever is in the room has the request itself and ignores this.

action.description: The action as the harness proposed it.

expires_at.description: When it expires, if it does.

reason.description: Why it was handed on, for the card and the audit.

routed_by.description: Who handed it on. Filled in by Chips from the credential.

routed_at.description: When. Filled in by Chips from its clock.

description: A pending approval handed to somebody else to answer (M5.5): a teammate, a role, or the lane's lead. Chips resolves `to` to ids, as it does on the request.
title: ApprovalRouted
